COMBATE.Cartas.Settings.modoCartas.Name: Card combat
COMBATE.Cartas.Settings.modoCartas.Hint: Each combatant draws a fresh hand at the start of their turn and acts by playing cards, replacing the action bar tabs. Rules and each character's cards live in the Combat cards menu.
COMBATE.Cartas.Settings.menu.Name: Combat cards
COMBATE.Cartas.Settings.menu.Label: Configure cards
COMBATE.Cartas.Settings.menu.Hint: Card mode rules, how many cards of each type each character has, and custom cards (using a sheet item or a macro).
COMBATE.Cartas.Settings.revelarCartas.Na: Show played cards in the middle of the screen
COMBATE.Cartas.Settings.revelarCartas.Hi: When someone plays a card, it flips and shows up large for a few seconds. Click to dismiss.
COMBATE.Cartas.Menu.personagensIntro: Leave blank for automatic (the grey number). Automatic reads the sheet: Attack = attacks per action (Extra Attack, Multiattack), Spell only for casters, Item only with usable items, Transform only with Wild Shape, Feature = copies of each sheet feature (0 turns it off). The character and enemy defaults apply to anyone without their own value.
COMBATE.Cartas.Menu.customIntro: Cards you create. The effect can be chat text only, using an item or feature from the sheet (good for homebrew classes), or running your own macro. The macro receives actor, token, combatant, carta, alvos and usuario. If the player can't run the macro, the GM runs it.
COMBATE.Cartas.Menu.campo.itemDica: Name or identifier of the item or feature on the player's sheet.
COMBATE.Cartas.Menu.campo.macroDica: Drag the macro here, or type its name or UUID.
COMBATE.Cartas.Menu.campo.classeDica: The dnd5e class identifier (e.g. druid, wizard, or your homebrew class's).
COMBATE.Cartas.tipo.atacar.texto: Make one attack with a weapon or natural attack.
COMBATE.Cartas.tipo.magia.texto: Cast a prepared spell. Spends the spell slot.
COMBATE.Cartas.tipo.item.texto: Use a potion, scroll or other item from your pack.
COMBATE.Cartas.tipo.mover.texto: Gain one extra speed of movement this turn.
COMBATE.Cartas.tipo.esconder.texto: Make a Stealth check to hide.
COMBATE.Cartas.tipo.transformar.texto: Use Wild Shape without spending its uses.
COMBATE.Cartas.tipo.esquivar.texto: Attacks against you have disadvantage until the start of your next turn.
COMBATE.Cartas.tipo.disparada.texto: Gain two extra speeds of movement this turn.
COMBATE.Cartas.tipo.ajudar.texto: Target an ally: they have advantage on their next attack or check.
COMBATE.Cartas.tipo.agarrar.texto: Athletics against the target. On a win, they are Grappled or Prone.
COMBATE.Cartas.tipo.armadilha.texto: Set face down. When someone attacks you, it triggers and you strike back.
COMBATE.Cartas.tipo.mais2.texto: Draw 2 random cards from your deck now.
COMBATE.Cartas.tipo.menos2.texto: The target (or the next in order) draws 2 fewer cards next hand.
COMBATE.Cartas.ajuda.descricao: Advantage on the next attack or check (Help card).
COMBATE.Cartas.mao.vazia: No cards. Your new hand arrives at the start of your turn.
COMBATE.Cartas.mao.dicaGuardar: Click a card to play it. Right-click keeps it for next turn.
COMBATE.Cartas.aviso.foraDoTurno: You can only play cards on your turn.
COMBATE.Cartas.aviso.semAtaque: This character has no attacks (equipped weapon or natural attack).
COMBATE.Cartas.aviso.semMagia: This character has no prepared spells.
COMBATE.Cartas.aviso.semItem: Nothing in the pack to use.
COMBATE.Cartas.aviso.semForma: This character has no Wild Shape.
COMBATE.Cartas.aviso.marqueAliado: Target the ally you want to help.
COMBATE.Cartas.aviso.marqueAlvo: Target who you want to grapple or shove.
COMBATE.Cartas.aviso.jaTemArmadilha: You already have a trap on the table.
COMBATE.Cartas.aviso.semAlvoCartas: No other combatant is playing with cards to receive the −2.
COMBATE.Cartas.aviso.customSumiu: The GM deleted this custom card.
COMBATE.Cartas.aviso.semItemCustom: The sheet doesn't have the item "{item}" this card uses.
COMBATE.Cartas.aviso.erroMacro: The macro "{nome}" failed. Check the console (F12).
COMBATE.Cartas.aviso.soCartas: In card combat, you act by playing cards from your hand.
COMBATE.Cartas.Settings.cartasTamanhoMao: How many new cards each combatant draws at the start of their turn.
COMBATE.Cartas.Settings.cartasAtacarGara: On: every hand has at least one Attack card (for anyone with an attack). Off: it's random.
COMBATE.Cartas.Settings.cartasGuardar.Hi: Right-click marks one card to keep. It stays for the next hand and takes one of its slots.
COMBATE.Cartas.Settings.cartasInimigos.H: GM combatants draw hands and act through cards, like players.
COMBATE.Cartas.Settings.cartasSomente.Hi: During combat, using anything that costs an Action or Bonus Action from the sheet or a macro is blocked for players. Reactions stay free. The GM is never blocked.
COMBATE.Cartas.Settings.cartasForaDoTurn: Lets players play cards when it isn't their turn.
COMBATE.Cartas.Menu.desligado: Card combat is off. Turn it on in the Combate da Mesa settings, Cards section.
COMBATE.Config.secao.cartas.descricao: In card mode, each combatant draws a fresh hand at the start of their turn. Playing a card performs the action right away without spending an Action or Bonus Action: the hand is the limit. Spell slots, ammunition and uses are still spent normally.
COMBATE.Cartas.tipo.habilidade.texto: Use this feature from your sheet. Spends its uses normally.
COMBATE.Cartas.aviso.semHabilidade: The sheet no longer has the feature "{nome}".
